verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own export paths. Agent trace runs can be copied as markdown, downloaded as JSON, or saved as a ZIP of markdown plus screenshots, and a Files API exists for managing files. Because the browser is open source and ships a pre-built Docker image, leaving the hosted service for self-hosting is plausible, but nothing shows a single complete export of all account data. Missing for 10: a documented account-wide export (sessions, profiles/auth context, credentials, recordings), explicit open-format guarantees across all data types, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a full export-and-leave workflow.
